name: Pleasing People
overview: Scripture teaches that true pleasing is found in seeking to honor God rather than men. Proverbs reveals that when a person's ways please the Lord, even enemies are made at peace, while fearing man leads to a snare, contrasting with trusting God who secures safety. The New Testament calls believers to offer themselves as living sacrifices, transformed by the renewing of the mind, to discern and fulfill God's perfect will. Ultimately, as Paul declares, seeking to please men is incompatible with being a servant of Christ, and believers are called to walk as children of light, reflecting their new identity in the Lord.
